description: Defines types, constants, and functions for accessing system time and timers, including monotonic and wall clock times, with conversion utilities between different time epochs.

methods.name: SbTimeGetNow
methods.description: Returns the current system time as an SbTime value.

methods.name: SbTimeGetMonotonicNow
methods.description: Returns a monotonically increasing time representing the current moment.

methods.name: SbTimeIsTimeThreadNowSupported
methods.description: Checks if the platform supports obtaining thread-specific timing information.

methods.name: SbTimeGetMonotonicThreadNow
methods.description: Returns a monotonically increasing time representing how long the current thread has been executing.
